annotations.text:
A is the chosen marketing template: one real photo, five words, one button. Picture first for the audience.

D is its companion for newsletters, announcements and general updates: one lead story with a photo, three short items, one action. Every number and date is a merge field.

Rules baked in: every fact in [BRACKETS], no fee percentage, no merchant counts, no instant-payout claim. System fonts so it survives every mail client.

Letterhead (A4, Archivo) sits beside them so the whole written set matches: export it as PDF from the toolbar.

Not chosen, kept for reference.

B  Founding Seller letter: reads like a personal message, WhatsApp as the action. Useful for outreach to the first 20 sellers.
C  Campaign push: navy hero, date pill, two photo tiles. Useful for a seasonal drive.
